detail.title: Smoke Alarm LZ-1902 sold via Trade Me stores
detail.metaDescription: Relacom Technologies Ltd are recalling the Smoke Alarm LZ-1902 because the online product listing incorrectly stated that the product provided carbon monoxide (CO) detection capability. The product is a smoke alarm only and does not provide carbon monoxide detection. If consumers rely on the product for carbon monoxide detection when it does not provide that function, they will not be alerted to the presence of carbon monoxide. Carbon monoxide exposure can lead to serious consequences including death. Stop using the product or relying on it for carbon monoxide detection. The product may continue to function as a smoke alarm; however, it does not provide carbon monoxide detection. Customers who purchased the product believing it also provided carbon monoxide detection should contact their seller to arrange a full refund.

records.title: Miele WWG880 WCS washing machine

detail.title: Miele WWG880 WCS washing machine
detail.metaDescription: The appliance’s spin cycle may operate with an incorrect speed acceleration, which may affect the machine’s overall performance. This can cause the machine to move during operation.  If the appliance is installed on a platform with a height over 15cm and the appliance is not secured with a mounting bracket in accordance with the Instruction Manual, it can move during operation and tilt off the platform. This can result in the appliance’s heating system not being covered by water, which creates a risk of overheating. The risk does not arise if the appliance is used on the ground, or on a platform lower than 15cm, or if the appliance is secured in accordance with the Instruction Manual. Owners of affected appliances will receive a software update and a mounting bracket to ensure that appliances that are used on a platform with a height over 15cm are securely installed in accordance with the Instruction Manual. Owners of affected appliances will be contacted by Miele to schedule a time for technician to visit, to ensure the software update is correctly installed and to ensure any appliances used on a platform with a height over 15cm are correctly installed. Note: Sufficient quantities of the brackets are currently available for the number of appliances estimated to be used on a platform with a height above 15cm. Further parts will be available and all consumers will receive a bracket whether or not the appliance is currently used on a platform. For further information, please contact Miele on 0800 4 MIELE.

The Warehouse advise that respirable asbestos has not been detected in any of the tested samples and the release of respirable asbestos fibres is unlikely to occur in its current state, unless the sand is processed by mechanical means such as crushing or pulverising. The Warehouse also advises that the risk that any asbestos which may be found in the product is likely to be airborne or fine enough for inhalation, is low. Stop using the products immediately. detail.title: STIHL MotoMix Pre-Mixed Fuel (5L)
detail.metaDescription: STIHL has identified that a limited batch of 5L MotoMix cans have been potentially leaking due to a manufacturing defect affecting the can (the MotoMix product itself is not affected). It is typically detected by the oily residue on the can or on surfaces on which the can was sitting, or a solvent aroma. There is a risk of injury including skin or eye irritation, drowsiness or dizziness or risk of harm if the fuel is handled or swallowed. The defect may also pose a fire hazard if the fuel leaks near an ignition source. Check cans for dates sold and stockists in the identifiers section and if leakage is detected, or you are concerned that your tin may be leaking, please follow these steps:• Handle carefully. MotoMix is a flammable substance and should be kept away from ignition sources, sparks, open flames, and excessive heat. Avoid breathing in fumes.• Place in a safe, well-ventilated area away from ignition sources.• Contact your local STIHL Dealer or STIHL Customer Service Support to arrange disposal and a refund under the Consumer Guarantees Act. Do not travel with leaking fuel cans.

detail.metaDescription: Modern Brands have recalled this product because independent laboratory testing has detected naturally occurring Chrysotile asbestos in some samples of Galt - Mini Makes - Sand Stickers. Importantly, no respirable asbestos has been detected. The presence of asbestos fibre bundles does not imply that there is a risk of asbestos exposure. Asbestos fibres are hazardous only if they are sufficiently fine, airborne and inhaled in sufficient quantity. The release of respirable asbestos fibres is unlikely to occur unless the sand is processed by mechanical means such as crushing or pulverising. While the risk that any asbestos found is likely to be airborne or fine enough for inhalation is low, this may still pose a risk. Stop using the products immediately. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Contact the retailer where you purchased the products for refund options with proof of purchase (eg. photo, receipt etc).
